The '''Tarantula Fang''' grants a {{stat|dmg|+200%}} bonus to and {{Stat|combat wisdom|+15}} against {{mt|Arthropod}} mobs. Its {{AN|Webcutter}} ability also allows the '''Tarantula Fang''' to break webs left by the {{MobSprite|Tarantula Broodfather}}'s {{AN|Web of Lies}} ability.
